episode_summary: In this episode, Austin Clarence discusses the impact of global oil prices on mortgage rates and the potential for future rate cuts. He highlights specialty mortgage programs for doctors, veterans, and self-employed individuals, offering unique benefits that many clients may not be aware of. Real estate agents can leverage this knowledge to better serve their clients and expand their business.
